scripts.cache::migrate: cd cache && bunx drizzle-kit generate && bunx drizzle-kit push
scripts.cache::prod: bun cache::migrate && cd cache && bun run index.ts
scripts.test::merge_coverage: bunx lcov-result-merger 'coverage/*_lcov.info' coverage/lcov.info && genhtml coverage/lcov.info -o coverage/html && lcov --list coverage/lcov.info && rm coverage/.lcov.info.*.tmp
scripts.test::all: bun test::cache::ci && bun test::shared::ci && bun test::merge_coverage && lcov --list coverage/lcov.info
